name: openbb_regulators_sec_search
description:
Search SEC-registered institutions (13F filers such as fund managers) by name through the OpenBB Platform (obb.regulators.sec.institutions_search); rows carry name and CIK.
Returns: {tool, provider, data_points (rows before the cap), truncated, data: rows with their dates, ignored_arguments when some did not apply} or {tool, error}.
Inputs (* required): query*; limit (rows returned, 1-1000; default 100; a dated series keeps its most recent rows); provider (sec; default sec).
Company search: edgar_company_search, openbb_equity_search; holdings: edgar_institutional_holdings. Keys: sec needs none.
Example: {"query": "Vanguard"}

limit.description: Most rows returned (1-1000); a dated series keeps its most recent rows
